scientific_limitations: The classification covers positive prime-two orbits only, at positive coexistence equilibria whose two coordinates do not exceed two.
The degenerate interaction determinant, equilibria with a coordinate exceeding two, boundary cycles and other periods are excluded.
The negative flip-characteristic determinant is not asserted to imply local attraction, a nondegenerate bifurcation, or global convergence.
Historical priority has residual uncertainty for incomplete access to some earlier full texts; finite checks do not prove global conclusions.
title: A sharp in-phase two-cycle census for low-load planar Ricker competition
